input.summary: Replace one-way Customer indemnity with a Vendor indemnity (IP, law, data breach, wilful misconduct), add standard procedure, exclusions and IP remedies, and narrow Customer's indemnity.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 20 currently gives Vendor a broad indemnity from us and gives us none, which is a walk-away position for us: we need Vendor to defend third-party IP infringement claims and claims arising from its breach of law, data breaches it causes, and its gross negligence or wilful misconduct. We have added the customary notice/control/cooperation procedure, the usual infringement exclusions and procure/modify/replace/refund remedies (which Section 9.3 already assumes exist at Section 20.5), and narrowed our own indemnity to Customer-provided content and our breach of law.

ops.oldText: 20.1 Customer shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Vendor from every claim relating in any way to Customer's use of the Services.
ops.newText: 20.1 Vendor shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Customer and its Affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (a) an allegation that the Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (b) Vendor's breach of Applicable Law; (c) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Customer Data caused by Vendor; or (d) Vendor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct.

ops.text: 20.2 Customer shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Vendor from and against third-party claims to the extent arising out of content or materials Customer provides to Vendor or Customer's breach of Applicable Law. 20.3 The indemnified Party shall give the indemnifying Party prompt written notice of the claim; the indemnifying Party will have control of the defence and settlement, provided that no settlement admitting liability or imposing an obligation on the indemnified Party is made without its prior written consent; and the indemnified Party will provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying Party's expense and may participate with its own counsel at its own cost. 20.4 Vendor's obligation under Section 20.1(a) does not apply to the extent a claim arises from Customer's unauthorized modification of the Services or Deliverables, their combination with items not supplied or recommended by Vendor, or Vendor's compliance with Customer's written specifications. 20.5 For a claim under Section 20.1(a), Vendor shall at its expense procure the rights necessary for Customer to continue using the affected item or modify or replace it with a functionally equivalent non-infringing item; if neither is reasonably achievable, Customer may terminate the affected Services or Deliverable and Vendor shall refund prepaid Fees and Fees paid for the affected item.
